a) Channel Layer (Top)
- Multiple messaging platforms (WeChat, DingTalk, Feishu, Terminal, Web)
- Each channel has its own implementation for message handling

b) Bridge Layer (Middle)
- Handles communication between channels and bots
- Manages context and reply formatting
- Acts as a middleware for message processing

c) Bot Layer (Core)
- Multiple AI model integrations (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.)

- Message processing logic

d) Plugin System (Side)
- Extensible plugin architecture
